visual_logic: Highlights the massive, wide, heavily reinforced bone-crushing beak morphology of Hatzegopteryx.
prompt: High-fidelity 3D asset of an exceptionally massive and wide Hatzegopteryx 'Axe' beak, rendered in a 3D animated feature film aesthetic with soft, stylized, and slightly rounded edges. The toothless jaw forms an incredibly stout, thick, and brutally strong spear-like structure with heavy, wide lateral profiles built to take massive physical impact. The texture is a rugged, matte keratin sheath with deep structural organic lines, colored in dense terracotta, charcoal-grey accents, and brick red tones. The specimen is oriented horizontally and perfectly centered in a 1:1 square composition, carefully scaled to occupy the central power-zone, ensuring a strict 25% negative space safety margin on all four sides. Placed flat against a neutral, 50% grey studio floor plane with high-contrast contact shadows to provide realistic physical weight and dramatic grounding. Illuminated by soft studio lighting with ambient occlusion to deeply emphasize the wide, destructive volume of the fossilized specimen.
